Block pressed with 4 N, tangential force 0.6 N = half the Coulomb limit, held constant; every contact node reports stick. checks.item: C1 Friction stick has no memory between load increments -> spurious creep that grows with the number of increments (directly corrupts the main endpoint: cage-centre translation > 1 mm and ratcheting over 6 directions x 3 cycles)
checks.evidence: GPU: the stick anchor is re-projected to the CURRENT closest point at the start of every increment (scripts/7_evo/gpufe/newton.py:192 and solver.py:356 call contact.py:106 set_anchor), so the tangential stick force restarts from 0 each increment and is rebuilt only by a new elastic slip tau/eps. FEBio does the same: FESlidingElasticInterface::Update re-projects (third_party/FEBio/FEBioMech/FESlidingElasticInterface.cpp:594-611) and then InitSlidingSurface sets m_rsp = m_rs at iteration 0 (cpp:684-688, 126-139); trial traction t = Lt + eps*dg uses that fresh anchor (cpp:857-866). Measured (V02): creep per hold increment GPU 0.0075 mm, FEBio 0.0151 mm at E 10 MPa; x4 increments -> x4 creep; scales ~1/E (E 400: 0.00019 mm per increment). Estimate tau/eps = 0.15 MPa / 26.9 N/mm3 = 0.0056 mm. A soft-phase PLCL cage with a few hundred increments would show tenths of a millimetre of fake slip. Gate 1c did not see it because it is displacement-driven sliding (scripts/7_evo/gpufe/gate1c_friction.py:41-42); its 'stick below the limit' phase has no tangential load. Agreement GPU-vs-FEBio in gate 4 would not catch it (both share the flaw). Standard return mapping keeps the elastic tangential slip as a history variable (Laursen & Simo 1993, Int J Numer Meth Eng 36:3451-3485; Wriggers 2006, Computational Contact Mechanics, 2nd ed., Springer).
fix_options: Keep the anchor (triangle + barycentrics) while a node sticks; on slip move the anchor to x_slave + (mu pn / eps) * slip direction (return mapping), so the carried tangential traction is exactly mu pn; re-project only nodes that slipped or left contact
Carry the tangential traction vector as a state variable (rotated with the master facet) and add eps * incremental slip (incremental return mapping)
Until fixed: report slip only as the difference to a run with 2x and 4x the increment count extrapolated to zero creep (expensive, weak)

checks.item: C2 Newton line search leaves the rigid-body state inconsistent when all trial step lengths fail
checks.evidence: scripts/7_evo/gpufe/newton.py:202-208: after the last failed trial the rigid states are restored (line 206) and a halved (207), but the loop ends and x = xn of the failed trial is accepted (208) with rigid nodes at the trial position while rb['c'], rb['R'] are the old values; the next _update re-applies the old rigid pose (_apply_rigid). The reported step 'a' is also wrong (1/64 printed, 1/32 used). Signature in human_study/evo/gpufe_verify/gate2/diag.log lines 9-10 and 13-14: |g| 2.0e-4 at a 0.016 then 3.6 (x18000) on the next iteration.
fix_options: On exhaustion keep the best trial: do not restore the rigid state for the accepted trial (or re-run _update with the accepted a)
Replace backtracking with a line search on the energy / residual projection along du (FEBio lstol style) and count a failed line search as a non-converged iteration

checks.item: C3 Unconverged increments are accepted silently (gate 2 so far: 3 of 3 increments not converged)
checks.evidence: newton.py:197-217 returns converged=False after max_newton and the driver keeps going (solver.py:447-449 only records it). human_study/evo/gpufe_verify/gate2/flex_pos_y_gpu.json: t 0.1/0.2/0.3 all 'converged': false, 60 iterations, rel_res 7.3e-6..7.5e-6 (tolerance 1e-6, newton.py:30). Tolerance itself is relative to |f_internal| (newton.py:211), which in a bone model is dominated by the stiff vertebrae, so a residual that matters for the cage can hide below it.
fix_options: Non-converged increment -> cut the increment (as FEBio's time stepper) and mark the run invalid if dtmin is reached; never write results from it
Add a second criterion on the reduced dofs of each body (rigid C3, cage nodes): |residual| < 1e-3 N and |moment| < 1e-2 N mm, plus energy norm |du.g| < 1e-10 of the first iteration (FEBio etol logic)

summary_zh:
結論：暫停（HOLD）。本輪還沒有任何設計，所以暫停的意思是：圖形處理器（GPU）求解器目前不能用來算「真實摩擦下支架會不會滑出」這個主要結果，第二關（完整頸椎節段比對）的數字也還不能算通過。

已確認沒問題的部分：我在自己的資料夾重跑第一關（材料公式的修補測試），結果與原報告逐位元完全相同，六種材料與彈簧的誤差都在 10 的負 8 次方以下；材料公式我也逐條對照了 FEBio 原始碼，一致。

最嚴重的問題（會讓結果錯誤）：摩擦的「黏住」狀態沒有記憶。我做了一個新測試：一塊方塊被壓住，再施加只有摩擦極限一半的側向力並保持不動。正確的物理答案是完全不動，但兩個程式都每個計算步就往前滑一點：軟材料（彈性模數 10 百萬帕）時，計算步從 10 增加到 40，GPU 的滑移從 0.04 增加到 0.15 公釐，FEBio 從 0.08 增加到 0.30 公釐。也就是說滑移量是計算步數造成的假象，而且材料越軟越大。支架要跑 6 個方向乘 3 個循環、幾百個計算步，這個假滑移可能達到判定滑出的 1 公釐門檻的一大部分。FEBio 本身也有同樣的缺陷，所以「GPU 和 FEBio 結果一致」不能證明正確。建議用接觸力學標準的「回推映射」方法修正（黏住時保留原錨點），修好且通過這個新測試之前，不使用任何真實摩擦的滑出數字。

其他重要問題：（1）牛頓法的線搜尋失敗時，剛體（第三頸椎）的位置記錄與節點位置不一致，第二關記錄中殘差一次跳大一萬八千倍；（2）第二關目前三個計算步全部沒有收斂，卻照樣記錄結果；（3）GPU 求解器、驗證腳本與所有輸出都沒有放進版本控制（git），結果檔也沒有記錄程式版本、輸入檔雜湊值與設定，第二關的執行腳本甚至不在專案裡，無法重現；（4）參考模型的小關節接觸在 FEBio 用「增廣拉格朗日法」（讓穿透幾乎為零），GPU 讀檔時默默忽略這個設定，只用罰函數，會讓小關節力偏小、活動度偏大；（5）第二關記錄顯示椎間盤與終板的黏合接觸力為零，可能根本沒有黏上（待執行腳本提交後確認）。

我也提出了第二到第五關的具體通過標準（例如活動度誤差不超過 5% 或 0.1 度、支架中心位移差不超過 0.1 公釐、計算步減半時位移變化不超過 0.05 公釐），並把第五關原本「動能小於應變能 1%」改為適用於牛頓法的收斂與平衡檢查。
